summary.name: Tryton
summary.one_liner: Tryton is a 100% open source business software suite covering accounting, sales, inventory, CRM, purchasing, manufacturing, and related business processes.
use_cases: running a small or medium business back office
tracking warehouse stock from receipt to delivery
manufacturing with bills of materials and routing
creating recurring invoices for customer contracts
automating communication with banks and carriers
summary.what_it_does: Tryton is business software offering fully integrated modules for financial accounting, analytic accounting, sales, inventory and stock, purchasing, supply chain, manufacturing, shipping, CRM, project management, and subscription management. Manufacturing uses bills of materials and routing to turn raw materials into finished products. Subscription management creates recurring invoices for customer contracts. A third-party integration module is described for automating communication with banks, carriers, and websites. The page also lists a Docker image and a demo server, and the project is licensed GPL-3.0 and written in Python according to the awesome-selfhosted listing.
notable: Modules are fully integrated across accounting, sales, inventory, manufacturing, and CRM
Includes manufacturing with bill of materials and routing
Subscription management for recurring contract invoices
Released under GPL-3.0 and written in Python
caveats: Page does not state hosting or installation requirements beyond the Docker image and download mentioned
Recent news items mention security releases and a certificate-related Docker image update
